article.headline: Milwaukee takes on Miami on 10-game skid
article.description: Milwaukee Bucks (1-13, 15th in the Eastern Conference) vs. Miami Heat (8-6, fourth in the Eastern Conference)
article.title: Milwaukee takes on Miami on 10-game skid
article.linkText: Milwaukee takes on Miami on 10-game skid
article.story: Milwaukee Bucks (1-13, 15th in the Eastern Conference) vs. Miami Heat (8-6, fourth in the Eastern Conference) Miami; Wednesday, 7 p.m. EST BOTTOM LINE: Milwaukee is looking to break its 10-game losing streak with a win over Miami. The Heat have gone 4-2 against Eastern Conference opponents. Miami is third in the league averaging 119.4 points and is shooting 47.2% from the field. The Bucks are 1-10 in conference play. Milwaukee is 1-11 against opponents over .500. The Heat are shooting 47.2% from the field this season, 1.1 percentage points higher than the 46.1% the Bucks allow to opponents. The Heat average 106.1 points per game, 13.0 fewer points than the 119.1 the Heat give up. TOP PERFORMERS: Bam Adebayo is shooting 52.9% and averaging 18.4 points for the Heat. Giannis Antetokounmpo is averaging 28.2 points over the last 10 games. Kyle Kuzma is shooting 45.0% and averaging 11.3 points for the Bucks. Jaime Jaquez Jr. is averaging 2.3 made 3-pointers over the last 10 games. LAST 10 GAMES: Heat: 8-2, averaging 123.5 points, 43.4 rebounds, 31.7 assists, 7.9 steals and 6.0 blocks per game while shooting 48.8% from the field. Their opponents have averaged 118.1 points per game. Bucks: 0-10, averaging 101.9 points, 42.7 rebounds, 24.1 assists, 7.5 steals and 4.8 blocks per game while shooting 40.9% from the field. Their opponents have averaged 118.7 points. INJURIES: Heat: Nikola Jovic: out (illness), Pelle Larsson: out (illness). Bucks: Ryan Rollins: day to day (illness), Ousmane Dieng: out (finger). ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
